summary: Brookfield Asset Management filed an 8-K on 2026-11-06 furnishing a press release reporting third-quarter 2026 results. The release disclosed $25 billion of Q3 fundraising and $123 billion year-to-date, quarterly fee-related earnings of $864 million (up 15% year-over-year, $0.54 per share) and distributable earnings of $763 million (also up 15%). Fee-bearing capital rose 13% to $682 billion, with roughly $50 billion of infrastructure commitments over the past year. Results reflect a previously announced presentation change for partner managers. The filing is a routine earnings current report, not a special situation; no advisory or structural angle to watch.
